summary_1line: Yudhishthira’s half-truth leads Drona to despair and death at Dhrishtadyumna’s hands, provoking Aswatthaman’s furious vow of revenge against the Panchalas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona, grief-stricken after hearing of Aswatthaman’s death, sits in meditation on the battlefield as Dhrishtadyumna seizes his hair and raises a sword.
Yudhishthira stands before Drona and speaks the fateful words about 'Aswatthaman,' while Bhima points toward the slain elephant lying huge as a hill.
Aswatthaman, eyes red and teeth clenched like a furious serpent, burns with rage upon hearing of his father’s death.
